What does carpet installation cost in Monroe, WA?

Figure $4–$7 per square foot installed in Monroe — that covers carpet, pad, labor, new tack strip and hauling off the old carpet. A single bedroom usually lands around $600–$1,000, and a typical project — a few rooms plus a staircase — runs $2,400–$3,900. Carpet grade swings the total more than anything else, and you pick it from full-size samples on your own floor.
Does your mobile carpet showroom come out to Monroe?

It does. The van carries 20+ carpet samples and all three pad grades to your door, whether that's a Fryelands two-story or a place up a gravel drive off Woods Creek. Samples go down on the actual floor in your own light, then every room and stair gets measured and you keep a written price from the same visit. The trip costs nothing.
How much is carpet stretching in Monroe?

Carpet stretching in Monroe starts at $99 per room, and most rooms come in between $99 and $180. A power stretcher pulls wrinkles, waves and loose edges flat for roughly a fifth of what replacement would run — the right call whenever the fiber is still healthy and you still like the carpet.
What does it cost to carpet stairs in Monroe?

Stair carpet starts at $18 per step, installed waterfall or cap-and-band style. A straight flight generally totals $235–$400. Landings and pie-shaped winders get measured into the written quote from the start, so nothing shows up later as an extra — what's on the paper is what you pay.
How long will my carpet installation take?

One day handles most Monroe homes. A few bedrooms plus a staircase is a standard day for the crew; a large farmhouse or a furniture-heavy two-story can carry into a second day. The timeline is written on your quote, so you know before install day, not during it.
Do you move furniture, or do I clear the rooms first?

We move it. Beds, couches, dressers and tables are included on most jobs, and the crew sets every piece back where it stood. You handle the small things — closet floors, electronics, breakables and anything personal you'd rather carry yourself.
Is my carpet worth stretching, or should I replace it?

If the pile still stands, the backing is sound and the color still suits you, stretching fixes it from $99 per room. Replace when traffic paths are matted flat, seams are pulling apart, the backing is breaking down, or pet odor has survived professional cleaning. We look first and tell you plainly which job you actually have.
Which Monroe neighborhoods and nearby towns do you serve?

All of Monroe — downtown, the Fryelands, Lake Tye and out along Woods Creek and Chain Lake Road — plus Florence Acres, the Tualco Valley, High Rock, Three Lakes, Lord Hill, Echo Lake, Maltby, Sultan, Startup, Snohomish and Duvall. Anywhere within about an hour of Monroe, the van will make the trip.
Which carpet holds up best with pets?

Solution-dyed nylon with a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad is the setup we install for pet households. The barrier keeps accidents out of the subfloor, which is where permanent odor starts, and solution-dyed fiber takes hard cleaning — even diluted bleach — without losing color. The moisture-barrier pad upgrade starts at $0.65 per square foot.
What warranty comes with the installation?

OC Flooring covers the workmanship with a 1-year warranty, and the carpet carries its own mill warranty on top — usually 10 to 25 years against wear and stains depending on grade. Both go on your written quote. Since the pad you choose can affect the mill's coverage, all three pad grades come to the measure so you can pick one that keeps it valid.
